             AND date(o.order_date) >= date(c.signup_date)
             AND date(o.order_date) <= date(c.signup_date, '+30 days')
         ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS activated
  FROM customers c
)
SELECT signup_month,
       COUNT(*) AS customers,
       SUM(activated) AS activated_customers,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(activated) / COUNT(*), 1) AS activation_rate_pct
FROM flags
GROUP BY signup_month
ORDER BY signup_month ASC

WITH agg AS (
  SELECT p.category AS category,
         SUM(oi.quantity * p.list_price) AS list_value,
         SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS realized_value
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY p.category
)
SELECT category,
       ROUND(list_value, 2) AS list_value,
       ROUND(realized_value, 2) AS realized_value,
       ROUND(100.0 * (list_value - realized_value) / list_value, 1) AS leakage_pct
FROM agg
ORDER BY leakage_pct DESC, category ASC

SELECT c.region AS region, t.priority AS priority, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.resolution_hours > CASE t.priority WHEN 'urgent' THEN 8 WHEN 'high' THEN 24 WHEN 'normal' THEN 72 WHEN 'low' THEN 120 END THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS breaches, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.resolution_hours > CASE t.priority WHEN 'urgent' THEN 8 WHEN 'high' THEN 24 WHEN 'normal' THEN 72 WHEN 'low' THEN 120 END THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS breach_rate_pct FROM support_tickets t JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id WHERE t.closed_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.region, t.priority ORDER BY c.region ASC, t.priority ASC

WITH RECURSIVE tree AS (
    SELECT e.employee_id AS root_id, e.employee_id AS employee_id, e.salary AS salary, 0 AS depth
    FROM employees e
    WHERE e.manager_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.root_id, e.employee_id, e.salary, t.depth + 1
    FROM tree t
    JOIN employees e ON e.manager_id = t.employee_id
)
SELECT r.employee_name AS executive,
       COUNT(*) - 1 AS report_count,
       SUM(t.salary) AS total_team_salary,
       MAX(t.depth) AS max_depth
FROM tree t
JOIN employees r ON r.employee_id = t.root_id
GROUP BY t.root_id, r.employee_name
ORDER BY total_team_salary DESC, executive ASC

WITH co AS (
    SELECT customer_id, order_date
    FROM orders
    WHERE status = 'completed'
)
SELECT c.customer_name AS customer_name,
       COUNT(*) AS completed_orders,
       ROUND((julianday(MAX(co.order_date)) - julianday(MIN(co.order_date))) / (COUNT(*) - 1), 1) AS avg_days_between_orders
FROM co
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY avg_days_between_orders DESC, customer_name ASC
